name: El Celler de Can Roca
dinnerNote: Festival menu: appetisers, 12 dishes and 4 desserts, for the whole table

menus.name: Festival Menu
menus.note: Appetisers, 12 dishes and 4 desserts; the whole table orders it; drinks extra, with an optional wine pairing

dressCode: No dress code, but the restaurant recommends dressing smartly, with long trousers and closed shoes for men.
duration: About three and a half hours.
bookingOpens: Online only, up to 11 months ahead. The next month's tables are released at midnight Central European Time on the 1st of each month. Tables are for 2 to 12 people.
waitlist: If your date is full, join the waiting list for that day on the booking page; each day has its own list, so you can sign up for several.
cancellation: No prepayment, but a credit card guarantees the booking. Cancel at least 10 days ahead for free; after that it's €100 per person. Please reconfirm by email 10 days before.
